errors.text_span: от първи квартал на 2023 г. до четвърти квартал на 2025 г.
errors.evidence: The x-axis shows monthly periods from I 2023 to IV* 2025, not quarterly periods.

errors.text_span: интервалите са равномерни и отразяват квартални периоди
errors.evidence: The x-axis is a monthly timeline with Roman numerals for months, not grouped into quarters.
The plotted minimum early in 2023 is around 81%, not 80%.

errors.text_span: след това се възстановява до около 95,0% през X 2023
errors.evidence: Around X 2023 the line is closer to 94-95%, so this is an acceptable approximation but slightly imprecise.

errors.text_span: за да достигне първия си връх около 112,0% през II 2024
errors.evidence: The first peak near 112% occurs around II 2024 and is acceptable, but the description later misstates subsequent extrema.

errors.text_span: следван от спад до 78,0% през XII 2024
errors.evidence: There is no drop to 78% at XII 2024; the visible trough around late 2023 is near 78%, while XII 2024 is around 103%.
The figure ends at IV* 2025, so there is no VIII 2025 point shown.
The final visible value at IV* 2025 is about 93%, not 92%.

errors.text_span: Регресионната линия следва обща тенденция на ръст с по-гладко изменение
errors.evidence: The dotted trendline rises and then falls toward the end; describing it as generally upward is an overstatement of the visible trend.
